To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have identified genes whose mRNA levels are altered in human liver cell line by microgravity.
the ground-based modeled micro-gravity system can induce significant changes in the gene expression of human liver cells.

the microgravity exposure induces significant changes in gene expression profiles of a human liver cell, and these changes include up-regulation of genes related to cell proliferation and apoptosis, and down-regulation of genes involved in the regulation of cell cycle, cell differentiation and cell growth.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of major genes that may be affected by microgravity exposure.
the identification of genes that are altered by micro-gravity exposure and the understanding of the molecular mechanisms of the effects of microgravity on human liver cell function.
the development of a systematic approach to the analysis of the effect of microgravity at the molecular level.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
exposure of human liver cells to simulated microgravity for 1,3, and 5 days results in the alteration of the expression of 139 genes.

the microgravity exposure caused a global gene expression profile change in human liver cell lines, which may be associated with a variety of cellular processes including cell cycle regulation, apoptosis, signal transduction, and transcriptional control.
the microgravity effect on gene expression in human liver cells is a complex and dynamic process that involves a large number of genes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the microgravity exposure caused a significant change in the expression of genes that are associated with cell cycle control and apoptosis.
microgravity induced a global change in gene expression profiles in human liver cells, and that the microgravity-induced changes in gene expression were time-dependent.
the microgravity exposure caused a significant decrease in mRNA levels for 78 genes, and a significant increase for 61 genes.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the microarray data analysis has revealed the expression profiles of the altered genes, and has provided the basis for the identification of the genes that are most significantly affected by microgravity.
microgravity exposure induces significant changes in gene expression profiles in human liver cells and that these changes can be monitored by DNA microarray technology.
a number of genes involved in cellular processes, such as cell cycle regulation, cell proliferation and apoptosis, and signal transduction, are altered by the modeled microgravity.
